subject: Hospitality
title: Green Hotels: Beyond Marketing
description: A fast breakdown of Green Hotels: Beyond Marketing for builders.

hook.text: Hotels consume enormous resources—a single guest uses 200+ liters of water per night. Sustainability is now urgent.

buildup.text: Green certifications like LEED, Green Key, and EarthCheck set standards for energy, water, and waste reduction.

discovery.text: Studies show 73% of travelers prefer eco-friendly hotels. Sustainability is becoming a booking decision factor.

twist.text: Greenwashing is rampant. Many hotels claim sustainability without meaningful action—towel reuse signs are not enough.

climax.text: Real green hotels invest in solar panels, water recycling, and local sourcing. The cost pays back in 3–5 years.

punchline.text: Green isn't just good ethics. It's good economics—and guests are watching.

quiz.question: What percentage of travelers say they prefer eco-friendly hotels?
